CAMPUS

The story of Lukenya institutions starts in 1991 at the place known as Lukenya hills in Mavoko (Athi river), Kathiani (now Machakos), where the founders the Late Honourable. Rtd Justice Kasanga Mulwa and his wife Martha Kasanga Mulwa, decided to establish the Lukenya Academy primary school on their cattle farm. As they say, the rest is history

University Overview

STUDYING
AT Lukenya University

The story of Lukenya institutions starts in 1991 at the place known as Lukenya hills in Mavoko (Athi river), Kathiani (now Machakos), where the founders the Late Honourable. Rtd Justice Kasanga Mulwa and his wife Martha Kasanga Mulwa, decided to establish the Lukenya Academy primary school on their cattle farm. As they say, the rest is history

Undergraduate

Lukenya University offers a diverse range of undergraduate programs designed to prepare students for global careers and leadership in various fields. We offer 19 undergraduate programs in total.

Mode of Study

◷ Online + On Campus

We offer 2 courses fully online and 17 delivered on campus.

View Programs

Master's

Advance your career with Lukenya University's masters programs. We offer 19 Master's degree programs across business, technology, health, and social sciences — designed for real-world impact.

Mode of Study

◷ Online + On Campus

We offer 14 courses on campus and 5 offered fully online.

View Programs

Doctorate

Advance your academic and professional journey with Lukenya University's doctorate programs. We offer 4 doctoral degrees across business, technology and social sciences — designed to drive original research, leadership, and real-world impact.

Mode of Study

◷ Online + On Campus

We offer 4 courses on campus

View Programs

Academic Programs

School of Business  and Economics

Over 80 bachelor's programs across arts, sciences, engineering, and business disciplines.

Business & Administration

School of Health and Sciences

Advanced master's degrees designed for specialized expertise and research excellence.

Sciences

School of Agriculture,  Technical Studies and  Natural Sciences

World-class PhD programs with renowned faculty mentorship and cutting-edge research.

Computing & Data Science

Experience Campus Life

Lukenya University has an active leisure and recreation portfolio which students find exciting. We believe that your education goes well beyond your coursework and degree from Lukenya University, for we believe in holistic education.

The university recognizes the need and has offered several mess/cafeterias that provide nutritious meals.

All Meals

Accommodation

Lukenya University is a residential university and provides accommodation to all students.

800+ Beds

Scholarship Programs

Lukenya University offers a variety of scholarships, grants, and work-study opportunities to help students finance their education and achieve their academic goals.
